ABOUT THIS PREVIEW

A private draft. A clear boundary.

By Max Fisher · Draft for review · 2026-10-29

This is a private website concept for MBRACE INSIGHT. The Four-ZIP Market Brief is the proposed starting offer. Service scope and field notes are drafts for review; the sample contains no real business findings.

Your brief scope

The builder uses your business name and website if supplied, market, ZIP codes, service, and question in this browser. It creates a worksheet download. Its application code does not submit those inputs to MBRACE, save them after a reload, create an account, or subscribe you to anything.

Discussing the brief

If you choose the email link after building a scope, your mail application opens a draft addressed to mfisher@mbraceinsight.com. That draft contains the scope you entered. You can edit or discard it before choosing to send. The site does not send email automatically.

Hosting and external references

The private site uses Sites hosting and ChatGPT sign-in. The hosting provider may process technical access information to deliver and protect the site. External reference websites have their own privacy practices. Fonts are hosted with the site, and the rooftop image is AI-generated illustrative imagery.

Before a public launch

Confirm the final service offer, privacy terms, editorial review, and any commercial disclosures. Live market feeds, analytics, CRM, and subscription integrations are not active in this concept.

A useful next step.
